name: qwen3.8-27b-nvfp4.pro6000ws-256k-fp8kv-dflash2.on-demand
purpose: On-demand RTX PRO 6000 WS profile for Qwen3.8 27B NVFP4 (RadixArk/Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4, modelopt MIXED W4A4/W8A8, ~20.4 GiB) + fp8_e4m3 KV cache, 64K context, DFlash2 W4A16 drafter n=7 (syvai). The club-3090 'ultrafast' tier — its real case is Blackwell sm_120+ where the 4-bit-activation groups run on FP4 tensor cores. NVFP4 KV is not usable on consumer Blackwell (trtllm-gen FP4 FMHA is sm_100/103 only), so KV stays fp8. DFlash2 (not MTP) => DFlash2 W4A16 template with the backport applied at boot. RISK: the RadixArk checkpoint quantizes lm_head to NVFP4 and the DFlash2 drafter shares the target lm_head (needs bf16) — if it fails at boot, revert speculative_config to method=mtp n=3. The last remaining decode lever vs the 4x3090-fp8 ~100 TPS reference.
